description: Replace this scene screen with the supported screen shape returned by get_project_context. Read get_project_context first. Saves a new version at once (restore_version undoes it); a change it cannot make is refused and nothing changes. Uses the direct-edit allowance. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: From get_project_context; the live version when left out.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A hook, Short or shape from check_video; the main video when left out.

screen.description: A screen in the shape get_project_context shows for that scene.

name: replace_scene_screen

outputSchema.description: Clypmint replace_scene_screen result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.
